- **The sleep:** it uses a constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL = 0.25`, with a comment noting the 5 requests per second limit. A 5/s limit needs at least 0.2 s between calls; the extra 0.05 s leaves some room for timing jitter.
- **Effect on the test:** `test_charges_roundtrip` makes four calls, so it now takes about one second longer.

I also saved the 5 requests per second limit to the project's shared memory (EngramDB), so later sessions know to space out any new tests that call the sandbox.
